phases.meaning: Save registers, compare signed wrapped clock delta, and branch around reread.
phases.entry_contract: Caller supplies stack and general registers. Five original saves stay in place.
Load and test signed state in DX. EAX holds 0/1 and is unchanged by the group.

phases.meaning: Extract the request, test the selected slot, and compute the lowering record index.
phases.entry_contract: EAX holds the input word sign-extended in reference and zero-extended in candidate. SAR followed by AND uses the same bits 13-15, and overwrites flags before they are consumed.
EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: Compute the primary record index and load its start tile.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.
AX is primary start tile; signed requested-slot reload into EDX precedes the tile store.

phases.meaning: Compute the primary record index and load its end tile.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.

phases.meaning: Compute the primary record index and load its projectile frame.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.
AX is primary firing tile; signed requested-slot reload into EDX precedes projectile-frame store.
EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: Convert the tile comparison to signed word direction 0 or -1 in AX.
phases.entry_contract: Signed comparison flags describe tile <= limit. SETLE, XOR AH, and DEC produce low AX, with upper bits and flags subsequently unused by the original path.

phases.meaning: Load the signed projectile type and call the original callback.
phases.entry_contract: The previous branch established that current tile equals projectile frame. EAX is overwritten with the signed type before the callback.

phases.meaning: Reject an unavailable secondary animation and reload the accepted request.
phases.entry_contract: The action equals 2. The group reads the request itself and does not consume incoming flags.

phases.meaning: Compute the secondary record index and load its start tile.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.
AX is secondary start tile; signed requested-slot reload into EDX precedes tile store.

phases.meaning: Compute the secondary record index and load its end tile.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.

phases.meaning: Compute the secondary record index and load its projectile frame.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.
AX is secondary firing tile; signed requested-slot reload into EDX precedes projectile-frame store.
EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

Incoming signed word CMP AX,DI flags describe tile <= limit. AX becomes 0 or -1 and is consumed by the store at 0x29f3f. Upper EAX is dead on either continuation; CMP DX,[weapon_tile] at 0x29f45 replaces the flags.
DX is the nonzero state. Promote to full EDX and check lowering and direction. EAX remains live at both lowering successors, so neither tick reads nor their flags move.

phases.meaning: Transition a finished lowering animation to the start of raising.
phases.entry_contract: Both signed tile boundary paths arrive here without requiring a tick. The state store does not consume incoming flags.
EDX carries the signed state after rejecting lowering. Test for start of raising.
EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: On a reverse raising tick, store the preceding tile and continue to offsets.
phases.entry_contract: ZF records the tick test (reference AX and candidate ECX both hold 0/1). BX contains the previous tile on both paths.
After reaching the raising limit, load the requested slot into AX. The unchanged reference suffix updates selected slot and idle state.
EDX is the signed state after rejecting raising. Test for firing and exit otherwise.
ZF records whether the signed direction word is zero. Either enter the reverse path or read tile and limit in their original order. The comparison flags remain live.

phases.meaning: Three-times-slot factor for forward firing ready tile
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: Compute the selected record index and load its ready tile after reverse firing.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended requested weapon. EAX becomes the signed ready tile in AX.

No live input register is required at the common offsets entry. Read displayed/tile in original order, compute signed frame and byte row offsets, read both in-DATA words, store X/Y, and restore the original five-save frame. Frame-relative incoming ESP must match the original prologue. All branch destinations within this group retain corresponding instruction boundaries.
